title.main: 忙碌生活中的喘息之椅

works.description: 將山脈紋路寫入設計裡，加深與加高的座椅讓人能有被群山環繞的安全感。以不同面料創造不同層次的平面。提醒人們在忙碌的生活當中隨時能找到與大自然聯繫的片刻。
works.longDescription:
這款家具設計靈感來自山脈輪廓融入造型，營造出自然流動的視覺感受。加深與加高的座椅結構，讓使用者在乘坐時能感受到彷彿被群山環抱的安全感。

不同材質的層次搭配，塑造出豐富的觸感與視覺變化，家具不僅是實用物件，更展現獨特的生活態度。提醒人們停下腳步，尋找與大自然連結的片刻，讓居家空間成為放鬆身心的避風港。
works.english: Incorporating mountain ridge patterns into the design, the elevated and deepened seating creates a sense of security, as if being embraced by towering peaks. Different fabrics are used to create layered surfaces, reminding people to find moments of connection with nature amidst their busy lives.
works.english_detail: This furniture design draws from mountain contours, blending flowing forms into its shape. The deepened, elevated seating offers security, as if embraced by peaks. Layered materials add rich tactile and visual contrast, making it more than functional—it reflects a unique lifestyle, inviting moments to reconnect with nature.

works.description: 將自然中的草木具象化，重新定義出室內燈具的輪廓。以透光及不透光的綠色布面相互搭配，減弱光線，讓光線的露出更加柔和。家中也能擁有一片使人放鬆盞盞燈光。
works.longDescription:
以樹木為靈感，透過骨架轉化枝幹的造型，使結構與線條呈現出有機且流暢的姿態。結合布面的層次變化，營造出光線柔和滲透的效果，彷彿陽光穿過樹葉間隙灑落，為空間注入自然與溫暖的氛圍。

不同材質的搭配，讓視覺層次更加豐富，並帶來細膩而舒適的觸感。如同置身大自然般的體驗，讓人在日常生活中感受到自然的寧靜與和諧。
works.english: This design reimagines indoor lighting through nature’s greenery. A mix of translucent and opaque green fabrics softens the glow, creating a gentle, calming light that transforms the space into a serene, illuminated retreat.
works.english_detail: Inspired by trees, this design transforms the structure into organic, flowing lines. Layered fabrics soften the light, like sunlight filtering through leaves, bringing warmth and nature to the space. The mix of materials adds depth and a comforting, nature-inspired atmosphere.
